tools.name: scan
tools.description: Run the Mjölnir verification scan on a directory and return the canonical machine contract (findings with ruleId/detectorRevision/evidence/trust, completeness fields, deterministic digest). One scan in flight; zero network; plugin gate applies unchanged.

path.description: Absolute or repo-relative directory to scan. Must exist.

maxDurationMs.description: Optional analysis budget in ms (pipeline budget).

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain one rule: what it detects, why it matters, how to fix it, plus its measured FP rate and trust metadata. Read-only; never runs a scan.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare a completed scan result against the target's committed baseline (.mjolnir/baseline.json) using the §15 lifecycle resolution. Returns new findings and per-disappearance resolutions (VERIFIED-RESOLVED / INCONCLUSIVE(cause) / SUPPRESSED / DISAPPEARED-NON-FIX). Read-only.

scanResult.description: The canonical ScanResult JSON previously returned by the scan tool.
